newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: NBB sees good response for Islamic fund.
newsitem.headline: NBB sees good response for Islamic fund.

text.p: National Bank of Bahrain (NBB) said on Wednesday its new Islamic investment fund had received good response from investors in Gulf Arab states.

"The fund has already attracted a very encouraging response from both Islamic and non-Islamic investors, not only in Bahrain but also in other GCC states where it is being actively marketed," a bank statement said.
GCC, an economic and political alliance, groups Bahrain, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, the United Arab Emirates and Kuwait.
On May 24 the NBB, the island's biggest commercial bank, launched the five-year al-Watani Fund for Islamic Investment which operates in accordance with Islamic law.
The minimum investment in the closed-ended fund is $10,000, priced at $100 per share. Moslems and non-Moslems can invest.
The fund will initially invest in a portfolio of global equities managed by Wellington Management Co, an independent investment adviser in the United States. -- Bahrain newsroom 973-524424
